content: परिमोक्षः .²1 Removing, relieving; प्रायो विषाणपरिमोक्षलघूत्तमाङ्गान् खड्गांश्चकार नृपतिर्निशितैः क्षुरप्रैः <ls>R. 9. 62</ls> ‘removing the horns’, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} breaking them down. .²2 Liberation, setting free, deliverance. .²3 Emptying, evacuation. .²4 Escape. .²5 Final beatitude (निर्वाण).
